authority: This remediation authorizes exactly one additional production behavior fix revealed after candidate.pt pathname reopening was removed: while the transferred delete-on-close checkpoint guard is live, its exact private staging hard-link name remains physically enumerable. Exact artifact validation must authenticate and separately classify that one held private alias instead of treating it as a public artifact or an unexpected entry. It is execution-authoritative over prior iteration-007 contracts only for this live-guard physical-set projection. Every replacement prepare receipt, execution spec, checkpoint metadata, execution receipt, validator, and test must bind all ten contract file hashes.

confirmed_defect.observation: After the v6 held-candidate path removed AccessDenied, eight real Windows artifact tests failed because os.scandir returned the delete-pending private `.candidate-<uuid>.staging.pt` name in addition to candidate.pt. The v6 physical name comparison expected only the public allowlist.
confirmed_defect.cause: inherited._publish_checkpoint_exclusive retains the exact staged inode through a StableFileGuard whose path is the private staging name and whose delete-on-close disposition cannot remove that directory entry until the guard closes. The same held inode also has the already identity-verified public candidate.pt hard link.

authorized_production_fix.scope: During checkpoint and status validation while the transferred checkpoint guard is live, validate two distinct sets: the exact public artifact allowlist from v4 and exactly one internal held staging alias derived from that guard. The physical direct-child set must equal their disjoint union. The internal alias is authenticated from the same guard and readback as candidate.pt, is never published as a result artifact, and disappears only when the existing owner closes the guard.

exact_internal_alias.source_of_name: checkpoint_guard.path.name only; never discover an allowed alias by scanning or prefix matching
exact_internal_alias.exact_parent: checkpoint_guard.path.parent must be the exact stable output directory
required_guard_state: the guard remains bound to the exact stable output-directory guard
the guard retains the verified inode identity
the guard's delete-on-close state is true
required_entry_state: the exact private alias occurs once in the direct os.scandir enumeration
it is a non-symlink, non-junction, non-reparse regular file
it is distinct from candidate.pt and every receipt and marker name
exact_internal_alias.byte_evidence: Do not reopen or hash the private alias by pathname. Assign it the same authoritative byte_size and SHA-256 as candidate.pt only after the live guard bytes equal the supplied checkpoint readback and that readback hashes to the expected candidate SHA-256.
exact_internal_alias.lifecycle: Do not unlink, rename, overwrite, adopt, or close the private alias inside inventory validation. The existing publication owner retains the guard through all live prechecks and postchecks and closes it in its existing finally path. Process exit also closes it. Delete-on-close then removes only the private staging name while the public candidate.pt hard link remains.

set_semantics.public_set: The exact v4 phase allowlist. It never contains the private staging name.
set_semantics.physical_set_rule: The sorted direct-child names must equal the disjoint union of the exact public set and the exact internal set. No generic dotfile, prefix, suffix, glob, second staging name, or unbound staging-looking name is ignored.
set_semantics.logical_result_rule: Receipts, markers, execution reports, and acceptance logic expose only the public set. The internal alias may appear only in diagnostic inventory evidence tagged internal_held_checkpoint_alias.
set_semantics.after_guard_close: The internal alias must be absent and the physical directory must contain exactly the public set. Real filesystem tests must verify this after every success, rejection, handoff, contamination cleanup, and exception close path.

authorized_production_fix.held_name_io_rule: Neither candidate.pt nor the exact internal alias may be reopened, read, stat-hashed, or reacquired by pathname while the transferred guard is live. Directory-entry metadata may classify both names. Receipt and marker files remain independently opened and hashed with the v6-restored share mode.
failure_and_cleanup: A missing internal alias, an additional staging-looking entry, a wrong alias name, parent, type, link state, guard identity, delete state, readback, size, or hash fails closed.
An unexpected public or internal entry before status publication creates no receipt or marker and is preserved.

Contamination after status publication removes only the newly owned receipt and marker after identity/hash verification. candidate.pt, the held internal alias, and unexpected entries are preserved until the ordinary guard close removes only the authenticated internal alias.
Checkpoint-identity handoff preserves the same candidate.pt, internal alias, guard, and readback; it creates no second checkpoint and may proceed only to the matching rejected status path.
No validation failure manually deletes the internal alias or closes a guard it does not own. Existing ownership and finally blocks remain authoritative.
forbidden_changes: ignoring every name matching .candidate-* or any other pattern-derived allowlist
treating the internal alias as a public artifact or persisting it in a terminal public allowlist
allowing zero or multiple internal aliases while a live checkpoint guard is supplied
opening either held name by pathname
closing the transferred guard early merely to make enumeration pass
manually deleting or renaming the internal alias
changing inherited conservative_ppo_pilot.py or its atomic checkpoint algorithm
weakening any exact public-set, type, link, identity, readback, hash, cleanup, collision, or second-checkpoint gate
changing any model, data, loss, optimizer, training, diagnostic, safety, acceptance, or schedule behavior
creating prepare v3, an execution spec, real optimizer state, or games before all required tests pass

required_fix_tests: For a real successful checkpoint, the live physical set is exactly candidate.pt plus the one exact internal guard alias, while the public projection is exactly candidate.pt.

For accepted and rejected status publication with a live guard, the live physical set is the exact three-file public terminal set plus the one exact internal alias; after the owner closes the guard, the alias is absent and the physical set equals the exact three-file public set.

For checkpoint-identity handoff rejection, the same guard alias and candidate identity survive through rejected status publication; after the owned guard closes, only candidate.pt, rejected_receipt.json, and REJECTED remain.
Instrument pathname opens so candidate.pt and the exact private alias both raise if reopened; all valid live checks still pass and receipt/marker bytes are independently verified.

candidate.pt plus EXTRA or a second staging-looking name fails before status publication, creates no receipt/marker, preserves unexpected entries, and after guard close removes only the authenticated private alias.

Missing private alias, wrong 31- or 33-character token, uppercase/nonhex token, wrong suffix, wrong parent, directory, symlink, junction, reparse, closed/foreign guard, false delete state, and readback/hash mismatch each fail closed.
Post-status injected contamination removes only the owned receipt and marker; after guard close candidate.pt and the injected entry remain and the private alias is absent.
Zero-step rejection continues to have no internal alias and exactly rejected_receipt.json plus REJECTED.
All v2-v6 mutation-sensitive membership, timing, confinement, artifact, and Windows held-evidence tests remain passing without weakening assertions.
prepare v1 and v2 remain byte-exact, prepare v3 stays absent during tests, and no real 830-row optimizer update or game runs.

replacement_prepare.publication: Create exactly once with CREATE_NEW semantics only after the authorized membership, artifact, timing, held-candidate, and private-alias fixes, every remediation-v2/v3/v4/v5/v6/v7 test, and all regressions pass. Preserve prepare v1 and v2 byte-exact.

execution_spec_override.loader_key_derivation: Preserve the prior 40-key v8 set as EXECUTION_SPEC_V8_TOP_LEVEL_KEYS by excluding only the v7 path/hash pair from the new v9 set. The v6 remediation loader must compare its override against that preserved v8 set; derive all older sets transitively without changing them.

stop_rule: After applying only the exact held-private-alias projection and all prior fixes, every required test and regression must pass before prepare v3 is generated exactly once. Then stop for independent code and numerical-provenance audits before execution-spec authoring. If any further production defect appears, do not alter production behavior without another root-authored correction.
